description: Use when an agent sizes leverage on a Hyperliquid perp or checks how close typical positions are to liquidation. Input: coin, optional leverages (e.g. 5,10,20). Output: JSON mark, max leverage, maintenance margin, long/short liquidation price and distance % per leverage, whether the 24 h range exceeds it, 24 h high/low, OI USD, funding APR and crowded side. Estimates, not a live liquidation feed. Example: ?coin=BTC Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Hyperliquid perp symbol (BTC, ETH, kPEPE) or HIP-3 dex:COIN (xyz:TSLA). Not listed or delisted: 400 before payment (not charged)

leverages.description: Comma-separated leverages 1-100 (default 2,3,5,10,20,25,40,50 up to the coin's max)

name: hl_liquidations
title: Hyperliquid liquidation price levels by leverage, vs the 24 h range, OI and funding crowding
